title: PolynomialParameterQuotientChart
statement: Let k be a field, Λ a commutative k-algebra, φ:P=k[y_i:i∈Fin m₀]→ₐ[k]Λ, and q a prime of Λ. Set p₀=φ⁻¹q, P₀=P_(p₀), L=Λ_q. Let R=k[Y_i:i∈Fin m] be equipped with a ring map R→Λ, E:R≃ₐ[k]P[t_i:i∈Fin d], uP:Fin d→P and tΛ:Fin d→Λ. Assume the images of uP generate p₀P₀, the extension of p₀ to L equals qL, tΛ_i∉q, and R→Λ sends E⁻¹(C z) to φ(z) and E⁻¹(t_i) to tΛ_i. Let n be any natural number, B=P/p₀^n and Q=R_(q∩R). Then there are H⊂R and e:R/H^n≃ₐ[k]B[t_i], such that HQ is generated by the images of E⁻¹(uP_i t_i), HL=m_L, e(E⁻¹(C z) mod H^n)=C(z mod p₀^n), and e(E⁻¹(t_i) mod H^n)=t_i. This is a polynomial quotient construction only; it asserts no rescaling, coefficient enlargement or A-factorization. Polynomial algebras, localizations and quotient algebra maps are those of the statement-dependency nodes.

proof.text: Identify R with P[t] via E and define H as the extension of p₀. In Q the new variables and the elements of P outside p₀ are units: their images in Λ lie outside q. Extend the parameter-generation identity from P₀ to Q, and multiply its generators by the units t_i. This proves HQ=(uP_i t_i)Q. The image of H in L is p₀L=qL=m_L by the extended-prime hypothesis and the maximal ideal formula for prime localization.

The image of p₀^n under coefficient inclusion is (p₀P[t])^n by Ideal.map_pow. Coefficient reduction P[t]→B[t] is surjective by lifting the finitely many coefficients, and its kernel is p₀^nP[t] because all coefficients of a polynomial vanish after reduction exactly when they lie in p₀^n. The quotient universal property gives e. Check the coefficient and variable formulas on representatives; they hold also when d=0 or n=0.

theorem exists_polynomial_parameter_quotient_chart
    {k : Type u} {Λ : Type w} [Field k] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k Λ]
    (m₀ m d n : ℕ) (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k →ₐ[k] Λ)
    (q : PrimeSpectrum Λ)
    [Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ]
    (E : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ≃ₐ[k]
      MvPolynomial (Fin d) (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k))
    (uP : Fin d → MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k) (tΛ : Fin d → Λ)
    (hparameters : Ideal.span
      (Set.range (fun i ↦ algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
        (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ.toRingHom)) (uP i))) =
      (q.asIdeal.comap φ.toRingHom).map
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
          (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ.toRingHom))))
    (hideal : q.asIdeal.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)) =
      (q.asIdeal.comap φ.toRingHom).map
        ((algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)).comp φ.toRingHom))
    (ht : ∀ i, tΛ i ∉ q.asIdeal)
    (hC : ∀ z : MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k,
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (E.symm (MvPolynomial.C z)) = φ z)
    (hX : ∀ i,
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (E.symm (MvPolynomial.X i)) = tΛ i) :
    let R := MvPolynomial (Fin m) k
    let P := MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k
    let p₀ := q.asIdeal.comap φ.toRingHom
    let B := P ⧸ p₀ ^ n
    let Q := Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.under R)
    let L := Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal
    ∃ (H : Ideal R) (e : (R ⧸ H ^ n) ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Fin d) B),
      H.map (algebraMap R Q) = Ideal.span
        (Set.range (fun i ↦ algebraMap R Q
          (E.symm (MvPolynomial.C (uP i) * MvPolynomial.X i)))) ∧
      H.map ((algebraMap Λ L).comp (algebraMap R Λ)) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal L ∧
      (∀ z : P, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (H ^ n) (E.symm (MvPolynomial.C z))) =
        MvPolynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (p₀ ^ n) z)) ∧
      (∀ i, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (H ^ n) (E.symm (MvPolynomial.X i))) =
        MvPolynomial.X i)
